description: Signaleringskaart riolering is a series of datasets listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De signaleringskaart riolering (traces) signaleert de locatie en de leeftijd van riolering. Op basis van het aanlegjaar zijn de rioleringen verdeeld in 4 leeftijdsklassen. Er is gebruik gemaakt van open data van de gemeente Rotterdam via Rotterdamopendata.nl. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are infrastructuur, riolering, rioolwater. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
